script.spoken: Amtrak Cascades train 501 derailed onto Interstate 5 near DuPont. Cars fell onto Interstate 5, and three people on board were killed. The train entered a curve at seventy eight miles per hour. The limit there was far lower. Positive train control wasn't active on the track. The engineer hadn't been adequately trained on the route. The NTSB faulted the transit authority for the curve's risk. Service waited for positive train control.
